item.nirncraft.lute.desc: Polished Colovian spruce lute strung with braided gut for hearthside ballads.
item.nirncraft.wooden_flute.desc: Honey-oak shepherd's flute favored by wayfaring minstrels from High Rock to the Rift.
item.nirncraft.frame_drum.desc: Rawhide hand drum painted with knotwork, beaten at stronghold hearths and longhouse feasts.
item.nirncraft.nord_war_horn.desc: Bronze-rimmed ox horn whose low fifths carry across snowy passes and misty fjords.
item.nirncraft.velothi_ash_flute.desc: Twin-bored chitin and ebonwood pipe bound in red resin, tuned to the mournful modes of Morrowind.
item.nirncraft.redguard_oud.desc: Deep-bowled rosewood lute with a bent pegbox, played in the courtyards of Sentinel and Taneth.
item.nirncraft.altmer_crystal_harp.desc: Gilded Summerset frame strung with resonant Aetherial quartz that shimmers when plucked.
item.nirncraft.bosmer_bone_pipe.desc: Graduated hollow bone syrinx lashed with Valenwood vine-cord in keeping with the Green Pact.
item.nirncraft.khajiit_sitar.desc: Gilded gourd-bodied sitar with sympathetic brass strings that hum like warm desert wind.
item.nirncraft.argonian_reed_marimba.des: Cured swamp-reed bars suspended over hollow gourds, echoing the steady pulse of the Hist.
society.nirncraft.song.nord.0: The White River runs from the Throat of the World, where the grey beards of stone keep their watch in the cold.
society.nirncraft.song.nord.0.title: The White River's Run
society.nirncraft.song.nord.0.0: The White River runs from the Throat of the World,
society.nirncraft.song.nord.0.1: Where the banners of winter in blizzards are furled;
society.nirncraft.song.nord.0.2: Raise the horn to the rafters and pour out the mead,
society.nirncraft.song.nord.0.3: For the shield-brothers sworn to the High King in need!
society.nirncraft.song.nord.1: Five hundred steps climb the wind-bitten stair, where the snow-wolves are howling through Kyne'sbitter air.
society.nirncraft.song.nord.1.title: Five Hundred Steps to the Cloud
society.nirncraft.song.nord.1.0: Five hundred steps climb the wind-bitten stair,
society.nirncraft.song.nord.1.1: Where the snow-wolves are howling through Kyne's bitter air;
society.nirncraft.song.nord.1.2: Though the frost takes the pine and the night takes the sun,
society.nirncraft.song.nord.1.3: In the Hall of Valor our feast has begun!
society.nirncraft.song.nord.2: From Windhelm's grey quayside the longships set forth, through the pack-ice and ghosts of the Sea of the North.
society.nirncraft.song.nord.2.title: Oars on the Sea of Ghosts
society.nirncraft.song.nord.2.0: From Windhelm's grey quayside the longships set forth,
society.nirncraft.song.nord.2.1: Through the pack-ice and fog of the Sea of the North;
society.nirncraft.song.nord.2.2: Let the gale split the mast and the salt freeze the oar,
society.nirncraft.song.nord.2.3: A Nord steers by stars to his ancestor's shore.
society.nirncraft.song.nord.3: In Whiterun the gildergreen blossoms in gold, while the horse-lords ride out over tundra and wold.
society.nirncraft.song.nord.3.title: The Gildergreen's Bough
society.nirncraft.song.nord.3.0: In Whiterun the gildergreen blossoms in gold,
society.nirncraft.song.nord.3.1: While the horse-lords ride out over tundra and wold;
society.nirncraft.song.nord.3.2: Come warm your cold hands by the Dragonsreach fire,
society.nirncraft.song.nord.3.3: And sing till the embers and lanterns expire.
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.0: Along the Red Ring where the stone bridges arch, the legions of Cyrodiil measure their march.
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.0.title: Bells of the White-Gold Tower
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.0.0: Along the Red Ring where the stone bridges arch,
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.0.1: The legions of Cyrodiil measure their march;
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.0.2: From Anvil's bright harbor to Bruma's high snow,
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.0.3: The bells of the White-Gold in evening still glow.
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.1: Sweet grapes of Skingrad are pressed in the fall, and the cellars run ruby beneath the West Wall.
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.1.title: Vintage of the Colovian Hills
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.1.0: Sweet grapes of Skingrad are pressed in the fall,
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.1.1: And the cellars run ruby beneath the West Wall;
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.1.2: A coin for the fiddler, a cup for the road,
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.1.3: May Dibella's own blessing lighten your load.
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.2: Down Nibenay's waters the silk barges glide, with lanterns of amber reflected beside.
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.2.title: Lanterns on Lake Rumare
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.2.0: Down Nibenay's waters the silk barges glide,
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.2.1: With lanterns of amber reflected beside;
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.2.2: The moths of the ancestors whisper in flight,
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.2.3: And crown the old Heartland with silver tonight.
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.3: When Morihaus breathed on the Pelinal blade, the chains of the Ayleids shattered and frayed.
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.3.title: The Covenant Rose
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.3.0: When Morihaus breathed on the Pelinal blade,
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.3.1: The chains of the star-kings were shattered and frayed;
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.3.2: Remember Saint Alessia's promise of old,
society.nirncraft.song.imperial.3.3: While eight steady stars in the heavens unfold.
society.nirncraft.song.breton.0: In Daggerfall's courts where the pennants are high, a knight and a conjurerThe tourney goes by.
society.nirncraft.song.breton.0.title: The Knight of Glenumbra
society.nirncraft.song.breton.0.0: Through Glenumbra's heather the grey chargers ride,
society.nirncraft.song.breton.0.1: With a spell on the lip and a lance at the side;
society.nirncraft.song.breton.0.2: For a Breton loves riddles and ribbons and fame,
society.nirncraft.song.breton.0.3: And a ballad that remembers his lady's fair name.
society.nirncraft.song.breton.1: By the Bjoulsae's green banks where the willow-trees lean, the barges of Wayrest sail down to the sea.
society.nirncraft.song.breton.1.title: Roses of Wayrest
society.nirncraft.song.breton.1.0: By the Bjoulsae's green banks where the willow-trees lean,
society.nirncraft.song.breton.1.1: The merchants of Wayrest count velvet andheen;
society.nirncraft.song.breton.1.2: Play softly, wood-flute, in the courtyard below,
society.nirncraft.song.breton.1.3: Before the high lords to their banquet-hall go.
society.nirncraft.song.breton.2: On the crags of Shornhelm where the ravens convene, the ancient stone towers look down the ravine.
society.nirncraft.song.breton.2.title: The Tower of Direnni
society.nirncraft.song.breton.2.1: First pillar of iron in mortal-kept lands;
society.nirncraft.song.breton.2.2: Though a hundred small kingdoms may quarrel and fall,
society.nirncraft.song.breton.2.3: The silver-tongued minstrel outlives them all.
society.nirncraft.song.breton.3: Never dance with the Wyrd when the moon's in the mist, or your ring-finger's bound and your forehead is kissed.
society.nirncraft.song.breton.3.title: The Wyrd-Tree's Warning
society.nirncraft.song.breton.3.0: Never dance with the Wyrd when the moon's in the mist,
society.nirncraft.song.breton.3.1: Or your ring-finger's bound and your forehead is kissed;
society.nirncraft.song.breton.3.2: Leave milk on the threshold and rosemary dry,
society.nirncraft.song.breton.3.3: When the hounds of the moorland go galloping by.
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.0: From lost Yokuda's sinking shore the Ra Gada set sail, with curved blades of memory that never bend or fail.
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.0.title: Sails of the Ra Gada
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.0.0: From Yokuda's sunken shore the Ra Gada set sail,
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.0.1: With curved blades of memory that never bend or fail;
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.0.2: Across the burning Alik'r the desert falcons wheel,
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.0.3: Where Frandar Hunding's wisdom lives in every arc of steel.
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.1: In Sentinel's white palaces the fountains cool the noon, and the oud-player plucks a song beneath the crescent moon.
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.1.title: Courtyards of Sentinel
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.1.0: In Sentinel's white palaces the fountains cool the noon,
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.1.1: And the oud-player plucks a song beneath the crescent moon;
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.1.2: The dates are sweet, the brass is bright, the harbor breeze is free,
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.1.3: And Stros M'Kai's red lanterns shine across the western sea.
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.2: Walk softly through the Tu'whacca sands where ancient heroes sleep, for Ruptga's tall and silent stars their nightly vigil keep.
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.2.title: The Far Shores' Stars
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.2.0: Walk softly through the shifting dunes where ancient heroes sleep,
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.2.1: For Ruptga's tall and silent stars their nightly vigil keep;
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.2.2: No necromancer's crooked hand may stir the honored dead,
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.2.3: Where Ash'abah have marked the stone and prayers of rest are said.
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.3: When Diagna's brass-clad riders came down from the mountain pass, the sand-storm sang like singing blades across the trocken grass.
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.3.title: Song of the Sword-Singer
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.3.0: A blade is naught of iron alone, nor forged by coal and tongs,
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.3.1: It is the breath within the wrist where discipline belongs;
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.3.2: Strike once for honor, twice for truth, and sheathe the quiet steel,
society.nirncraft.song.redguard.3.3: Till Tava's wind brings rain again and desert blossoms heal.
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.0: Beneath Red Mountain's smoking plume the silt-striders cry low, and ash falls soft on fungal towers where ghost-lights come and go.
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.0.title: Ash on the Foyada
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.0.0: Beneath Red Mountain's smoking plume the silt-striders cry low,
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.0.1: And ash falls soft on mushroom towers where lanterns come and go;
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.0.2: Breathe deep the Velothi flute, Sera, and draw your mantle tight,
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.0.3: Our ancestors are listening beside the hearth tonight.
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.1: By Azura's twilight star we walked when Resdayn still was young, before the False Tribunal's names in temple halls were sung.
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.1.title: Moon-and-Star of the Ashlands
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.1.0: By Azura's twilight star we walked when Veloth led the way,
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.1.1: Where grazeland wind and chitin tents outlast the House's sway;
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.1.2: The Wise Woman reads the ember-smoke, the Ashkhan keeps the spear,
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.1.3: And Nerevar's old promise rings for those with ears to hear.
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.2: From Blacklight's cliff to Mournhold's square the Great Houses contend, with parchment, poison, prayer and coin their honor to defend.
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.2.title: Lanterns of the Canton
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.2.0: From Blacklight's cliff to Mournhold's square the Great Houses contend,
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.2.1: With parchment, blade and whispered oath their honor to defend;
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.2.2: Yet pour a cup of sujamma for traveler and kin,
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.2.3: When red ash beats against the door of the cornerclub within.
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.3: In Telvanni roots of spiraling spore the wizard keeps his tower, and cares no whit for king or law beyond his study hour.
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.3.title: Spire of Sadrith Mora
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.3.0: In Telvanni roots of spiraling spore the master keeps his tower,
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.3.1: And cares no whit for king or law beyond his study hour;
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.3.2: Float upward on a levitation charm of luminous blue,
society.nirncraft.song.dunmer.3.3: Where Zafirbel Bay's mushroom rings are wet with evening dew.
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.0: Crystal-Like-Law in the morning light rang with a thousand chimes, keeping the measure of Aldmeris across the mortal times.
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.0.title: Chimes of Alinor
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.0.0: In Alinor the glass-winged ships catch sunlight on the bay,
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.0.1: And crystal harps in terraced courts salute the dawning day;
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.0.2: Each note is weighed in golden proportion, eight and three,
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.0.3: A memory of Aldmeris beyond the Pearled Sea.
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.1: When Auri-El ascended high on eagle-feathered flame, he left the bow and left the shield to guard the Elven name.
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.1.title: Hymn to Auri-El's Ascent
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.1.0: When Auri-El ascended high on eagle-feathered flame,
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.1.1: He left the bow and left the laws to guard our ancient name;
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.1.2: Though mortal seasons haste and fade like blossom on the bough,
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.1.3: The patient stars of Syrabane keep watch upon us now.
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.2: In Lillandril the sages read the astrolabe of gold, and trace the paths of Magnus where the atlas-tides unfold.
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.2.title: The Astrolabe of Lillandril
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.2.0: In Lillandril the sages read the astrolabe of gold,
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.2.1: And trace the paths of Magnus where the atlas-tides unfold;
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.2.2: Touch gently now the quartz-strung harp and let the fourth ascend,
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.2.3: Where poetry and geometry in faultless order blend.
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.3: Far from the groves of Firsthold where the silver lilies bloom, a wandering scholar keeps the song that banishes the gloom.
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.3.title: Gardens of Firsthold
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.3.0: Far from the groves of Firsthold where the silver lilies bloom,
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.3.1: A wandering scholar keeps the air that banishes the gloom;
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.3.2: May Xarxes ink your lineage in letters clear and true,
society.nirncraft.song.altmer.3.3: And Mara twine the myrtle-wreath when summer comes anew.
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.0: No blade may cut the living bough, no axe may wound the tree; we sing upon the hollow bone what Y'ffre gave to be.
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.0.title: Oath of the Green Pact
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.0.0: No blade may cut the living bough, no axe may wound the tree,
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.0.1: We pipe upon the hollow bone what Y'ffre gave to be;
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.0.2: From Falinesti's walking crown to Haven's mossy shore,
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.0.3: The forest knows the hunter's step and keeps the Green evermore.
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.1: When Falinesti walked the south in eras long ago, its lanterns hung like fireflies a hundred leagues below.
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.1.title: The Walking Graht-Oak
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.1.0: When Falinesti walked the south in seasons long ago,
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.1.1: Its lanterns hung like fireflies a hundred cubits low;
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.1.2: Now spinners weave the story-thread in Elden Root's deep hall,
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.1.3: And every leaf that never falls remembers who we call.
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.2: Pour out the frothy jagga cup and pass the roasted haunch, upon the swaying rope-walk where the canopy-archers launch!
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.2.title: Jagga in the Canopy
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.2.0: Pour out the frothy jagga cup and pass the roasted haunch,
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.2.1: High on the swaying vine-bridges where nimble archers launch;
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.2.2: A friendly theft between good friends is returned with a grin,
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.2.3: While bone-pipes trill like hoarvors when the twilight settles in.
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.3: Listen to the Spinner's tale beside the hearth of bone: a name is but a borrowed song until the tale is grown.
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.3.title: The Spinner's Thread
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.3.0: Listen to the Spinner's tale beside the lamp of bone:
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.3.1: A life is but a borrowed verse until the deed is known;
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.3.2: Step lightly through the fern-shade where the indrik's antlers gleam,
society.nirncraft.song.bosmer.3.3: For Valenwood is half awake and half inside a dream.
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.0: Jone and Jode are shining bright above the Rimmen road, where caravan bells jingle soft beneath the silken load.
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.0.title: Two Moons Over Elsweyr
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.0.0: Jone and Jode are shining bright above the Rimmen road,
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.0.1: Where caravan bells jingle soft beneath the silken load;
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.0.2: This one plucks the brass sitar and shares the sugar-cake,
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.0.3: May warm sands lie beneath your paws whichever path you take.
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.1: Rajhin stole the Empress' ring and laughed upon the roof, leaving only moonlight and a shadow for a proof!
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.1.title: Seven Shadows of Rajhin
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.1.0: Rajhin stole the Empress' ring and danced upon the tile,
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.1.1: He paid the guard in compliments and vanished with a smile;
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.1.2: So lock your chest with seven bolts, good walker, if you please—
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.1.3: A Khajiit only borrows what is rusting in the breeze!
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.2: In Senchal's spice-bazaars the sails of crimson canvas blow, and moon-sugar is measured out where Tenmar waters flow.
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.2.title: Bazaars of Senchal
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.2.0: In Senchal's spice-bazaars the sails of crimson canvas blow,
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.2.1: And sweet cane-gold is measured out where Tenmar waters flow;
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.2.2: From tiny Alfiq on the rug to Senche-raht in pride,
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.2.3: The Lunar Lattice binds our kin across the desert wide.
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.3: Azurah shaped the desert folk from secret, purr and grace, and taught the sitar how to sing in every market-place.
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.3.title: Azurah's Three Secrets
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.3.0: Azurah shaped the desert folk from twilight, purr and grace,
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.3.1: And taught the sitar how to hum in every market-place;
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.3.2: When cold winds bite in foreign holds and tavern doors are barred,
society.nirncraft.song.khajiit.3.3: Come sit beside the caravan fire and listen to the bard.
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.0: Rain upon the broad-leaf reed, ripple on the pool; the Hist remembers yesterday when stone and star have cooled.
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.0.title: Pulse of the Root-Song
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.0.0: Rain upon the broad-leaf reed, ripple on the pool,
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.0.1: The Hist remembers yesterday when stone and star have cooled;
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.0.2: Strike the gourd-marimba low and let the mud-drum speak:
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.0.3: All rivers find the root again, however far they seek.
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.1: Xanmeer steps of mossy stone rise out of Murkmire's mist, where Sithis turns the wheel of change and nothing is amiss.
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.1.title: Steps of the Sunken Xanmeer
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.1.0: Xanmeer steps of mossy stone rise out of Murkmire's mist,
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.1.1: Where roots drink deep the amber sap of the eternal Hist;
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.1.2: The dry-skins build their walls of lime to keep the river out,
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.1.3: We swim between the fallen blocks and neverneed to doubt.
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.2: In Lilmoth when the monsoon falls the reed-boats line the quay, and lanterns glow in mangrove boughs above the drowned sea.
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.2.title: Monsoon Over Lilmoth
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.2.0: In Lilmoth when the monsoon falls the reed-boats line the quay,
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.2.1: And lanterns glow in mangrove boughs above the shallow sea;
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.2.2: Erect the spine and wet the scale, good Saxhleel, take your oar—
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.2.3: The current knows the shortest road from marsh to harbor shore.
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.3: A stone that fights the flowing stream is ground to sand at last; the reed that bows before the flood stands upright when it's past.
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.3.title: The Reed and the Current
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.3.0: A stone that fights the flowing stream is ground to sand at last,
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.3.1: The reed that bows before the flood stands upright when it's past;
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.3.2: Beat three upon the hollow wood, beat four upon the skin,
society.nirncraft.song.argonian.3.3: Where ending is beginning's kin and seasons fold within.
society.nirncraft.song.orc.0: Beat the iron on the block and stretch the bull-hide drum, for Malacath keeps tally of the strong who overcome!
society.nirncraft.song.orc.0.title: Anvil of the Stronghold
society.nirncraft.song.orc.0.0: Beat the iron on the block and stretch the bull-hide drum,
society.nirncraft.song.orc.0.1: For Malacath keeps tally of the strong who overcome;
society.nirncraft.song.orc.0.2: Nopretty words of courtly grace will temper orichalc,
society.nirncraft.song.orc.0.3: We prove our worth in sweat and scars where mountain tempests walk!
society.nirncraft.song.orc.1: High in Wrothgar's granite peaks Orsinium was raised, a hundred hearths of hammered bronze where forge-fires ever blazed.
society.nirncraft.song.orc.1.title: Walls of Old Orsinium
society.nirncraft.song.orc.1.0: High in Wrothgar's granite peaks Orsinium was raised,
society.nirncraft.song.orc.1.1: A hundred hearths of hammered bronze where forge-fires ever blazed;
society.nirncraft.song.orc.1.2: Though kings have burned our palisades, our blood is iron-cast:
society.nirncraft.song.orc.1.3: Whenever two strong smiths remain, Orsinium shall last.
society.nirncraft.song.orc.2: By the Code of Mauloch stand and speak no hollow lie: pay blood price or theforge-tongs' weight beneath the open sky.
society.nirncraft.song.orc.2.title: The Blood-Price Drum
society.nirncraft.song.orc.2.0: By the Code of Mauloch stand and speak no hollow lie,
society.nirncraft.song.orc.2.1: Pay blood-price or the hammer's weight beneath the open sky;
society.nirncraft.song.orc.2.2: The Wise Woman tends the ancestor-pit, the Huntsman tracks the bear,
society.nirncraft.song.orc.2.3: And every child of Trinimac earns what they forge and wear.
society.nirncraft.song.orc.3: When the war-horn shakes the palisade and winter wolves draw near, the stronghold drums answer the night without a breath of fear.
society.nirncraft.song.orc.3.title: Watchfires of Narzulbur
society.nirncraft.song.orc.3.0: When frost-wind shakes the palisade and winter wolves draw near,
society.nirncraft.song.orc.3.1: The stronghold frame-drums answer back without a breath of fear;
society.nirncraft.song.orc.3.2: Drink bitter ale from horn and bowl, and whet the heavy blade—
society.nirncraft.song.orc.3.3: No oath an Orsimer has sworn was ever left unpaid.
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.0: The Karth runs red through juniper and crags of riven slate; the Old Gods of the misty hills remember who is great.
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.0.title: Drum of the Karth Spire
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.0.0: The Karth runs swift through juniper and crags of riven slate,
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.0.1: Where eagles nest above the clouds at Druadach's windy gate;
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.0.2: Beat low the painted goatskin drum beside the standing stone,
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.0.3: Before the Nords had named a hold, these mountains were our own.
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.1: Faolan's red eagle banner flew above the sundered pass, and ten-score antlers crowned the host across the mountain grass.
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.1.title: Legend of the Red Eagle
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.1.0: Faolan's burning blade was forged in Rebel's Cairn of old,
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.1.1: When ten-score clans of Reach-folk stood against the foreign gold;
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.1.2: He sleeps beneath the cairn-stone till the hills are free again,
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.1.3: And bone-pipes call the antlered host from every misty glen.
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.2: Hircine walks the briar-wood when autumn moons are red; the hunter and the hunted share the moss where they are led.
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.2.title: Song of the Briar-Heart
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.2.0: Hircine walks the briar-wood when autumn moons are high,
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.2.1: And every stag upon the crag looks upward to the sky;
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.2.2: Take nothing that you have not earned by flint and sinew-string,
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.2.3: For in the Reach the mountain wind is the only lasting king.
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.3: Markarth is built of Dwemer brass, cold stone upon cold stone, but underneath the waterfall the river speaks its own.
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.3.title: Waters Under Markarth
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.3.0: Markarth is built of Dwemer brass, cold stone upon cold stone,
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.3.1: Yet underneath the waterfall the river speaks its own;
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.3.2: The silver-miners swing the pick, the guardsmen walk the wall,
society.nirncraft.song.reachman.3.3: While Reachmen sing the older names that outlive hall and all.
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.0: One breath is in the pine and bear, one breath is in the sea; the All-Maker has woven us in everything that be.
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.0.title: Song of the Six Stones
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.0.0: One breath is in the pine and bear, one breath is in the sea,
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.0.1: The All-Maker has woven us in everything that be;
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.0.2: By Wind and Water, Earth and Sun, by Beast and rooted Tree,
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.0.3: We keep the circle whole upon the shores of Felsaad's sea.
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.1: Across Lake Fjalding's frozen mirror the northern auroras play, and the great hearth of the Greathall drives the Greedy Man away.
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.1.title: The Greathall Hearth
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.1.0: Across Lake Fjalding's frozen glass the green auroras play,
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.1.1: And the great hearth of the Greathall drives the Greedy Man away;
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.1.2: Take only what the winter spares and thank the horker's tide,
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.1.3: So when our cycle ends at last in peace we shall abide.
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.2: Sound low the carved war-horn across the Mortrag snow, to guide the lost hunter home when blinding blizzards blow.
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.2.title: Horn Over Solstheim
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.2.0: Sound low the carved war-horn across the Mortrag snow,
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.2.1: To guide the weary hunter home when blinding blizzards blow;
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.2.2: Though ash from south Vvardenfell may stain the glacier grey,
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.2.3: The Skaal remember Tharsten's lesson and the older way.
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.3: From Atmora's frozen elder-wood our fathers crossed the main, and left the bronze-bound horn to sing through sleet and icy rain.
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.3.title: Echoes of Elder Wood
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.3.0: From Atmora's frozen elder-wood the ancient keels came down,
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.3.1: Before a stone was ever laid for castle, hold or crown;
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.3.2: Keep faith with wind and snow-bear's track, keep truth upon your tongue,
society.nirncraft.song.skaal.3.3: And let the horn of Solstheim sound as when the world was young.
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.0: Eastward beyond the Padomaic where no Imperial charts agree, the serpent-ships of Akavir ride out upon the sea.
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.0.title: Wind from the Padomaic
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.0.0: Eastward beyond the Padomaic where no old charts agree,
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.0.1: The lacquered prows of Akavir ride out upon the sea;
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.0.2: A bamboo flute of seven holes, a blade of folded steel,
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.0.3: And strange constellations turning round the eastern shipman's wheel.
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.1: In Tang Mo's thousand monkey-isles the mist is warm and green, and bells of bronze ring through the bamboo where no king has been.
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.1.title: Isles of the Thousand Bells
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.1.0: In Tang Mo's thousand misty isles the monsoon rains are green,
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.1.1: And temple bells ring through the reeds where no High King has been;
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.1.2: Though Kamal's snow-demons thaw and march when summer breaks the ice,
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.1.3: The island folk stand shoulder-fast and never yield them twice.
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.2: Through Pyandonea's veil of fog the sea-serpents uncoil, and Maormer sails of translucent scale skim past the mortal soil.
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.2.title: Fog of Pyandonea
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.2.0: Through Pyandonea's veil of fog the great sea-serpents glide,
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.2.1: Where Orgnum's coffer mints the gold beneath the southern tide;
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.2.2: Beware the storm that smells of kelp when not a cloud is near,
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.2.3: And steer your cog toward Anvil's light before the sails appear.
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.3: A wanderer has no single hold, his roof is every sky; he trades a tune from far Cathnoquey for supper warm and dry.
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.3.title: The Wayfarer's Compass
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.3.0: A wanderer has no single hold, his roof is every sky,
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.3.1: He trades a tune from Cathnoquey for supper warm and dry;
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.3.2: From Yneslea to Esroniet the sea-roads rise and fall,
society.nirncraft.song.foreign.3.3: And every tavern hearth in Nirn is cousin to them all.
